requirements_summary: Workloads: low-latency chat (driver-assist), real-time reranking during route computations, nightly batch embeddings updates.
Latency targets: p95 <= 120ms for chat inference under steady-state; p95 <= 320ms during cross-region failover (target <200ms preferred).
Throughput: baseline 500 concurrent sessions (avg 40 tokens/sec), peak surge up to 1,800 concurrent sessions for short windows (30-90min).
Failover/headroom: minimum 30% warm-standby capacity per region; if region outage, traffic should failover to nearest region with <2s detection+re-route window.
GPU hardware preference: H100 for NA & EU reserved pools; A100 for APAC pilot to reduce commitment; require transparent perf profiles by model/seq-length.
KV/prefix caching: cross-region replication to minimize cold-start cost; acceptable cold-start penalty <200ms additional p95.
Routing policy: prefer regional serving by default; automatic fallback to compatible quantized model variant if capacity constrained.
Observability: token-level latency/cost breakdown, per-route dashboards, and immediate alarming for tail-latency regressions.
Compliance: EU data residency for EU-origin requests; must support KMS and audit logging with 1-year retention (negotiable).
sla_expectations: Regional uptime warranty: 99.95% (monthly) for Dedicated pools; tiered service credits for misses.
Latency SLO: p95 tail latency guarantees per route (definitions to be finalized), with concrete thresholds tied to committed capacity.
Failover guarantees: failover detection+re-route <2 seconds; during failover, p95 should not exceed committed threshold by more than 100ms (preferred <80ms).
Capacity guarantee: Reserved GPU pool must be available for 99.9% of business-critical windows (06:00-22:00 local).
Maintenance windows: notified 72 hours in advance; blackout windows for critical events negotiable at contract signature.
reserved_gpu_plan: NA (us-west-2): 40 H100 reserved for primary serving + 12 H100 warm-standby (30% headroom).
EU (eu-west-1): 24 H100 reserved primary + 8 H100 warm-standby (33% headroom) with EU-only control plane option for residency.
APAC (ap-southeast-1): 12 A100 reserved for pilot + 4 A100 warm-standby; plan to convert to H100 if performance/ARR justifies.
AZ placement: minimum 2 AZs per region; prefer AZ spread across fault domains (explicit AZ IDs to be confirmed by infra team).
Bursting: contractual burst pool of up to 25% additional capacity billed at premium rate, subject to availability across regions.
Autoscaling policy: constrained to not exceed committed reserved pool for predictable billing, with explicit burst throttle rules and hysteresis.
Canary rollout: incremental canaries across zones with automatic rollback; require ability to pin traffic percentages per AZ during rollout.
Caching strategy: regional KV caches with async replication; cold-start mitigation via pre-warming heuristics tied to traffic forecasts.
